T: Every town needs a dog like this.
D: The true-ish story of a wandering red kelpie who united a mining town in the Pilbara.
P: Serve the mains when the miners at the pub start telling Red Dog stories.
S: Dampier pub loaded chicken salt chips
the pub in Dampier where the stories get told

Thick double-fried chips hit with chicken salt, smothered in gravy and melted cheddar, with pickled jalapeño and spring onion on top. Cut 1.2kg potatoes into thick chips, fry at 140C for 6 minutes, rest, then at 180C for 4 minutes until crisp. Toss with 2 tsp chicken salt. Make gravy: melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 400ml beef stock and a dash of Worcestershire and simmer until thick. Pile the chips on a tray, scatter with 150g grated cheddar, pour over the hot gravy and top with sliced pickled jalapeño and spring onion.
Pork sausage rolls with grated onion and carrot, served hot with tomato sauce
Sausage mince with grated onion and carrot rolled in puff pastry, egg washed, baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Tomato sauce.
Garlic and chilli squid grilled hot and fast, finished with lime and coriander
Tender squid scored and charred on a hot barbecue with chilli, garlic and lime. Score 600g cleaned squid tubes and cut into pieces.
M: Dampier sausages, steak and potato salad
Charcoal beef sausages and rump steak, fried onions, mayo potato salad, white bread

Thick beef sausages and rump steaks grilled over coals, onions fried on the hotplate, with potato salad dressed in mayo and chives and a stack of white bread. Boil 1kg potatoes until tender, cool and dress with mayonnaise and chives. Grill 8 thick beef sausages and 4 rump steaks over hot coals. Fry 2 sliced onions on the hotplate until golden. Serve it all with a stack of white bread and the potato salad.
Pilbara barra tacos with lime slaw
the coast up north near the mine

Spice-dusted barramundi seared on a hot plate, flaked into charred tortillas with lime and chilli slaw, pickled red onion and a smoky chipotle mayo. Mix 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp cumin and salt and rub over 800g barramundi fillets. Pickle 1 sliced red onion in lime juice and salt. Toss a quarter cabbage, shredded, with lime juice, chilli and coriander. Mix 120g mayonnaise with 1 chopped chipotle. Sear the fish in a hot oiled pan for 3 minutes a side and flake. Char 12 small flour tortillas and fill with fish, slaw, onion and mayo.
W: Sponge cubes dipped in raspberry jelly and rolled in coconut
Butter sponge cut into cubes, dipped in raspberry jelly that's just starting to set, rolled in desiccated coconut, chilled until firm. Red and fluffy.
K: Lager topped with fresh ruby grapefruit soda over ice, soda only for drivers

Ice-cold lager cut half and half with fresh ruby grapefruit soda, red-tinged and sharp, served in frosty stubby holders with a grapefruit wedge. Juice 2 ruby grapefruits and stir with 2 tbsp caster sugar until dissolved, then mix with 400ml cold soda water. Chill well. Half fill 4 tall glasses or stubby holder cups with cold lager, top with the grapefruit soda and add a grapefruit wedge. Serve the grapefruit soda on its own for the drivers.

s.note: Pork sausage rolls with grated onion and carrot, served hot with tomato sauce
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with a grated onion and a grated carrot. Lay along the edge of 2 halved puff pastry sheets, roll up and seal. Brush with beaten egg, cut into pieces and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve hot with tomato sauce.
